messages:
ashley: Pipeline blocked: premerge SAST failing with KMS decrypt error on artifact fetch. Buildkite job 5823. Error: AccessDenied for cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. Anyone take a look?

tom: I saw an alert. Logs show 403 from KMS. Which SA is being used by the scanner?

ashley: scanner-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com per job config.

jules: probable IAM binding missing after key rotation last night. Can you paste the error?

ashley: log snippet:
```
2026-03-23T15:02:11Z buildkite-agent[5823]: kms:Decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Caller does not have permission to use the key
```

maria: Check Cloud Audit Logs for 'AccessDenied' entries under cloudkms.googleapis.com. If key rotation removed the binding, we should see the denied principal.

tom: If this is a rotation fallout we should do ephemeral grant to unblock the pipeline and then fix infra repo. I can open a temporary grant with 2-hour TTL.

jules: Prefer IAM condition instead: add binding with condition limited to `resource.name` or `serviceAccount`. But quick unblock -> temporary binding.

ashley: Can someone run this? I'm mid-PR. Command to add binding:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci-keys/cryptoKeys/scanner-key --member="serviceAccount:scanner-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```

tom: I'll apply ephemeral via gcloud and post audit link. Will add comment in infra PR to make permanent with condition.

sre-oncall-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4621 - pipeline KMS decrypt failure (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4621) — assigned to @tom. Priority: P2

maria: Also check artifact access logs: storage.objects.get denied? If scanner can't fetch the encrypted artifact, both IAM for storage and KMS matter.

ashley: Storage access was fine earlier; artifact fetch logged 'decryption error' specifically. I ran a local reproduce and got same KMS error.

jules: After temporary grant, let's run postmortem: include timeline, why rotation removed binding, and add automation to validate bindings after rotation.

tom: :thumbsup: applying now, will record exact change and TTL.

tom: Applied binding with condition expire_time="2026-03-23T18:30:00Z" via gcloud. Pushing infra PR to follow up: infra#789

ashley: Pipeline retriggered and now SAST passed. Thanks!

maria: I'll pull audit logs and dump entries to the ticket. Also recommend we add a pre-rotation check in keystore rotation playbook to ensure scanner bindings preserved.

jules: Add test to nightly e2e to run SAST against a smoke repo so rotation breaks are caught early.

ashley: Created follow-up checklist in SEC-4621 with owners: infra (tom), sec (jules), devex (ashley).

tom: If this happens again, escalate to oncall SRE. I'll update runbook.

sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: SEC-4621 updated with temporary binding details and infra PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789
